Name: Bundle Pool Probe
Author: Awassakura
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]

This mod adds custom maps designed to generate the items required for [b]Community Center Bundles[/b] — including [b]Remixed Bundles[/b] and bundles added by other mods, such as those from [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]. If you enjoy bundle progression but want a more controlled, less RNG-dependent way to gather bundle items, this mod provides dedicated locations where those items can be obtained.

A green [color=yellow][b]Warp Crystal[/b][/color] is placed on your farm by default, usually near the Farmhouse. Interacting with it grants access to the custom bundle-item maps. On custom farm maps the crystal may appear in an unexpected location — if you cannot find it, use the GMCM option described below or explore the farm edges.

[heading]Main Features[/heading]

[list]
[*][b]Custom bundle-item maps[/b]: Dedicated areas that spawn items required by Community Center Bundles.[/*]
[*][b]Warp Crystal[/b]: Placed on the farm for quick access. Default position is near the Farmhouse; on custom farms the position may be unusual and require exploration.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing map[/b]: One of the custom maps can be fished at [b]any time and in any weather[/b]. In theory, every fish required for Bundles should be catchable there, regardless of season, weather, or time-of-day restrictions.[/*]
[*][b]GMCM support[/b]: Two configurable options via Generic Mod Config Menu — Warp Crystal position, and forageable spawn count/interval in the custom rooms.[/*]
[/list][b]A note on the GMCM options[/b]: I want to be upfront — due to my current technical limitations, neither option is fully polished. The Warp Crystal position option is mainly for custom farm maps where the default location falls outside the walkable area. The forageable spawn count defaults to [b]1[/b]; a low value can occasionally result in failed spawns. Increasing it gives more consistent results, but setting it too high will make bundle completion trivial and, frankly, quite boring.


[heading]How to Downlo[/heading]
[list]
[*]Download and install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod, then place it into the Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Future Plans[/heading]

The following features are planned, but [b]they may take time[/b] — I’ve been working on this mod for several days and would like to actually enjoy playing the game for a bit first.

[list]
[*][b]Movie Theater bundles[/b]: Support for [b]The Missing Bundle[/b] and related Movie Theater bundle content.[/*]
[*][b]Progressive map unlocking[/b]: Maps unlock gradually as bundle progress advances, instead of all being available from the start.[/*]
[*][b]Unlockable Bundles compatibility[/b]: I will try my best to add support for bundles created through the [b]Unlockable Bundles[/b] framework.[/*]
[*][b]Breakable containers[/b]: Attempting to place basic items such as Wood and Stone into mine-style [b]Crates and Barrels[/b]. I know how to do this with Content Patcher and Farm Type Manager, but this mod currently relies on code, so it will take some time.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] — for the two configuration options[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]

[color=green][b]Tested and working[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] — the SVE bundle set is supported in my testing.[/*]
[*][b]Custom farm maps[/b] — theoretically supported. Some small farms may place the Warp Crystal outside the map boundary with default settings; use the GMCM position option to correct this.[/*]
[*][b]Bundles modified without Unlockable Bundles[/b] — theoretically supported.[/*]
[/list][color=red][b]Known incompatible[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]None encountered so far. If you run into a compatibility issue, please report it in the [b]Posts[/b] or [b]Bugs[/b] tab and I will look into adding support where possible.[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout Outs[/heading]

This mod was inspired by [b]Lnh’s Community Center Item Output Points[/b] by [b]liunianhui[/b]. That mod provides a similar concept, but it only supports the game’s default bundles — it does not support [b]Remixed Bundles[/b] or added bundles such as those from SVE. I made this mod to fill that gap. Thanks to liunianhui for the original idea.
---------------------------------
[heading]模组简介[/heading]

这个模组添加了几个自定义地图，专门用于生成[b]社区中心捆绑包[/b]所需的内容，包括[b]重新混合[/b]后的捆绑包以及其他模组添加的捆绑包（例如 [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] 的捆绑包）。如果你喜欢捆绑包进度，但希望用更可控、不那么依赖随机刷新的方式收集捆绑包物品，这个模组提供了固定的地点来获取这些物品。

农场地图上会生成一个[color=yellow][b]绿色传送水晶[/b][/color]，默认位置在农舍附近。与水晶互动即可进入用于获取捆绑包物品的自定义地图。在自定义农场地图上，水晶可能出现的位置会比较奇怪——如果找不到它，可以使用下面的 GMCM 选项调整，或者沿着农场边缘探索一下。

[heading]主要功能[/heading]

[list]
[*][b]自定义捆绑包物品地图[/b]：专门生成社区中心捆绑包所需物品的区域。[/*]
[*][b]传送水晶[/b]：生成在农场上，方便快速进入。默认位置在农舍附近；在自定义农场上位置可能比较奇怪，需要用户自行寻找。[/*]
[*][b]钓鱼地图[/b]：其中一个自定义地图可以钓鱼，[b]不受时间和天气限制[/b]。理论上，捆绑包中要求的鱼类都应当可以在这里钓到，不受季节、天气或时间段的原版限制。[/*]
[*][b]GMCM 支持[/b]：通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 提供两个可调选项——传送水晶位置，以及自定义房间中觅食物品的生成数量和周期。[/*]
[/list][b]关于 GMCM 选项的说明[/b]：需要坦白说明，受目前技术能力限制，这两个选项都还不够完善。传送水晶位置选项主要用于解决自定义农场地图上默认位置落在可行走区域之外的问题。觅食物品生成数量默认为 [b]1[/b]，数值较低时偶尔会出现生成失败的情况；调高数值可以让结果更稳定， 但是设置太大了就会变得太强以至于很无聊了不是吗？



[heading]如何下载：[/heading]
[list]
[*]下载安装SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载安装Content Patcher（常说的CPmod）。[/*]
[*]下载本mod，解压到Mods文件夹里即可。[/*]
[/list]


[heading]未来计划[/heading]

以下功能在计划中，但[b]可能需要一些时间[/b]——我已经做了几天的模组，想先爽快地玩几天游戏。

[list]
[*][b]电影院的捆绑包[/b]：支持 [b]The Missing Bundle[/b] 以及与电影院相关的捆绑包内容。[/*]
[*][b]随进度解锁地图[/b]：地图随着捆绑包解锁进度逐渐开放，而不是像现在这样默认全开。[/*]
[*][b]兼容 Unlockable Bundles[/b]：我会尽量尝试支持通过 [b]Unlockable Bundles[/b] 框架创建的捆绑包。[/*]
[*][b]可破坏容器[/b]：尝试将木头、石头等基础物品放入类似矿井里那样的[b]木箱和木桶[/b]中。说实话，如果使用 Content Patcher 和 Farm Type Manager，我知道怎么做，但目前这个模组依赖代码实现，所以需要一些时间。[/*]
[/list][heading]前置需求[/heading]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]——用于两个配置选项[/*]
[/list][heading]兼容性[/heading]

[color=green][b]已测试可用[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b]——在我的测试中，SVE 自带的捆绑包是支持的。[/*]
[*][b]自定义农场地图[/b]——理论上支持。部分小型农场在默认设置下可能把传送水晶生成在地图边界外，需要用 GMCM 的位置选项进行调整。[/*]
[*][b]未通过 Unlockable Bundles 修改过的捆绑包[/b]——理论上支持。[/*]
[/list][color=red][b]已知不兼容[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]目前还没有遇到。如果你发现了兼容性问题，欢迎在 [b]Posts[/b] 或 [b]Bugs[/b] 板块反馈，我会尽量添加支持。[/*]
[/list][heading]致谢[/heading]

本模组的灵感来源于 [b]liunianhui[/b] 制作的 [b]Lnh’s Community Center Item Output Points[/b]。那个模组提供了类似的概念，但它只支持游戏原本的默认捆绑包，不支持[b]重新混合[/b]后的捆绑包，也不支持 SVE 这类添加的捆绑包。我制作这个模组正是为了填补这个空缺。感谢 liunianhui 的创意。
